payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped multi-key overlap window for stored push credential encryption. FRICK_PUSH_CRED_KEY is the primary (all new writes); optional FRICK_PUSH_CRED_KEY_PREVIOUS (comma-separated base64 32-byte keys) lets old-key blobs still decrypt during rotation, retired by dropping it. decryptCredential tries primary then each previous in order. Env-var only, no API changes. New tests/push-credentials-rotation.test.ts (5 tests). typecheck exit 0; server vitest 793 passed / 45 skipped.
